using CUDA
import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "JACC") || Pkg.add(name = "JACC", version = "1")
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "Atomix") || Pkg.add("Atomix")
import JACC
import Atomix
JACC.@init_backend

using JSON3

function initstacks_clamped_sumsq_b(i_n)
    branch_stack = Vector{Int64}(undef, div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function clamped_sumsq_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, i_n, branch_stack)
    w = 0.0
    wb = 0.0
    for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
        if u[i_seq_x] > 0.0
            branch_stack[(i_seq_x - 1) + 1] = 1
            w = u[i_seq_x] ^ 2
        else
            branch_stack[(i_seq_x - 1) + 1] = 0
            w = 0.0
        end
        loss[1] = loss[1] + w
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
        wb = wb + lossb[1]
        __branch = branch_stack[(i_seq_x - 1) + 1]
        if __branch == 1
            ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + (2 * u[i_seq_x]) * wb
            wb = 0.0
        else
            wb = 0.0
        end
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_clamped_sumsq_b_jacc(i_n)
    branch_stack = JACC.zeros(Int64, div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function clamped_sumsq_b_jacc(loss, lossb, u, ub, i_n, branch_stack)
    w = 0.0
    wb = 0.0
    JACC.@parallel_for range = div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1 jacc_kernel_clamped_sumsq_b_1!(branch_stack, i_n, loss, u)
    JACC.@parallel_for range = div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1 jacc_kernel_clamped_sumsq_b_2!(branch_stack, i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    return nothing
end

function jacc_kernel_clamped_sumsq_b_1!(__jacc_i, branch_stack, i_n, loss, u)
    i_seq_x = 1 + (__jacc_i - 1)
    if u[i_seq_x] > 0.0
        branch_stack[(i_seq_x - 1) + 1] = 1
        w = u[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    else
        branch_stack[(i_seq_x - 1) + 1] = 0
        w = 0.0
    end
    Atomix.@atomic loss[1] += w
    return nothing
end

function jacc_kernel_clamped_sumsq_b_2!(__jacc_i, branch_stack, i_n, lossb, u, ub)
    i_seq_x = i_n + (__jacc_i - 1) * -1
    wb = 0.0
    wb = wb + lossb[1]
    __branch = branch_stack[(i_seq_x - 1) + 1]
    if __branch == 1
        ub[i_seq_x] = ub[i_seq_x] + (2 * u[i_seq_x]) * wb
        wb = 0.0
    else
        wb = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 4
__base_loss = Float64[-0.11864806372175375, -0.5230284796468124, 1.1433380579846186, 1.2492738557378589]
__base_u = Float64[0.5977136653337521, -0.3519372757905681, -0.3087272913215061, 0.34796415692579374]
__seed_loss = [Float64[0.34219300453666535, -1.246174330596824, -0.8863557574285044, -0.8616183867111387], Float64[-0.006356085377310449, 2.0243719706362517, -0.09120889568456134, 0.36560122975842274], Float64[0.11124421977284868, 0.10647097085246271, -0.29578197859244193, 1.681293385531068]]
__seed_u = [Float64[0.018165049413416377, -0.3503905779255408, -0.8483911494673023, 0.5407342436095933], Float64[0.9619412791230252, 0.3304279379459919, 1.692512669526912, -0.5236721246168022], Float64[0.580662357825161, 1.9079623394593295, 0.7314201076412462, 0.0905030578720727]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:3
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = JACC.array(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = JACC.array(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = JACC.array(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = JACC.array(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_clamped_sumsq_b, Any[i_n])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_clamped_sumsq_b_jacc, Any[i_n])
  ret_cpu = clamped_sumsq_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = clamped_sumsq_b_jacc(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()
  ret_gpu_t = ()
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
